about: KB-OWN-EXIT2: files that still end a run through process.exit, each to set process.exitCode and let the event loop end, then come off this list (scripts/support/process-exit.mjs). It shrinks to empty; nothing is added. Paths are grouped under their top folder, so the list names no script by its repository path: it is data the check compares against, and a script it names is not run by the step that reads it (scripts/support/affected-gpu.mjs follows named paths).
